en: The image is a sepia-toned studio portrait of a young man standing with his arms folded, dressed in what appears to be early 20th-century sailor or worker attire. He stands next to a small ornate table. The background consists of a plain wall with wood paneling. The bottom of the postcard features decorative text, including what appears to be a photographer's name and studio location.
